purpose: identify actionable v4.1 bottlenecks; v3.6 is a lightweight fixed-input pure-forward reference and is not an optimization target

methodology.v4_1_scope: fixed-input forward scaling, component events, CPU/GPU packing, recurrent length, legal-count distribution, PyTorch Profiler, and duplicate-work audit
methodology.synthetic_fixture: shape/dtype-valid deterministic tensors generated once at maximum batch and sliced so each batch uses the same prefix; not a learning or gameplay-quality input
methodology.timing: three repeat samples; CUDA events measure device work and host wall time is retained separately; component hooks do not replace the executed model graph
methodology.interpretation_limit: microbenchmarks choose later optimization experiments but do not establish end-to-end training speedup

observation_conversion.finding: env.step constructs the next observation, but the worker does not reuse result.observation and calls env.observation again at the next decision

central_stack_and_mask_copy.finding: each central batch allocates three np.stack outputs and copies observation, card indices, and action mask to device

card_embedding.finding: v4.1 computes card_embedding/card_projection once per forward and reuses the resulting card_tokens

semantic_position_tensor.finding: _v41_semantic_context recreates torch.arange(4) on every call instead of reusing a registered static buffer

device_validation_sync.finding: Python bool conversions validate device tensors in forward_step and masked_logits, forcing host-visible scalar results in the inference hot path

bottleneck_ranking.ranking_basis: shared root cause in central inference and learner forward
bottleneck_ranking.next_experiment: remove repeated static tensor creation/device scalar sync one candidate at a time, then remeasure fixed batches

bottleneck_ranking.candidate: central batch occupancy and reusable input buffers
bottleneck_ranking.ranking_basis: independent central opportunity after the shared model hot path; fixed-input latency stays nearly flat as batch grows
bottleneck_ranking.next_experiment: scan batch wait/workers before changing execution semantics

bottleneck_ranking.ranking_basis: large pipeline consumer, but partly overlaps the first shared-network candidate and must not be double-counted
bottleneck_ranking.next_experiment: profile minibatch kernels and test buffer/layout reuse without changing PPO epochs or sequence boundaries

bottleneck_ranking.ranking_basis: confirmed semantic-preserving candidate with smaller measured wall-time scope
bottleneck_ranking.next_experiment: reuse the exact next-decision observation only after a trajectory/action-mask equivalence test
